name: assisted single leg press
description: A machine press done with one leg at a time, helping you build leg strength and fix imbalances.
instructions: Sit on the machine and place one foot on the platform.
Release the safety and lower the platform until your knee is bent about 90 degrees.
Press through your heel to straighten the leg without locking the knee.
Keep your hips on the seat. Finish the reps, then switch legs.
